title: Example: move retry policy to its owner

sections.title: Recommendation
sections.body_html:
• Give retry decisions one owner.
  • This example demonstrates a proposal, not a confirmed runtime bug.

sections.title: Target design
sections.body_html:
• Worker owns orchestration and resource teardown.
  • RetryPolicy owns attempt limits and retry decisions.
  • Target also consolidates the second caller; that migration follows the first PR.

evidence.text: Isolated policy tests could reduce setup cost.
evidence.source: Illustrative design; verify real callers and tests before proposing this extraction.

sections.title: Validation
sections.body_html:
• Proposed, not executed: assert retry decisions at the attempt limit.
  • Retain integration coverage for cancellation and worker teardown.

sections.title: First PR
sections.body_html:
• Extract retry decisions for one worker and add focused behavior tests.
  • Preserve attempt limits and failure propagation.
  • Defer the second caller migration; the first step is independently useful.
